slides.title: Writing Tests
slides.content:
# Pytest 🧪

Simple and powerful testing!

```python
# test_math.py
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

def test_add():
    assert add(1, 2) == 3
    assert add(-1, 1) == 0
    assert add(0, 0) == 0
```

```bash
pytest test_math.py
```

> 💡 **Just use `assert`!** No boilerplate needed.
